stdout:
Manage nfr documents.

Usage: papyrus nfr [OPTIONS] [COMMAND]

Commands:
  create        Create a nfr document.
  create-group  Create a nfr group.
  list          List nfr documents.
  view          View a nfr document.
  edit          Edit a nfr document.
  archive       Archive a nfr document.
  delete        Delete a nfr document.
  status        Set the status of a nfr document.
  help          Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --json           Emit stable, machine-readable JSON.
      --dir <path>     Project directory. Default: the current working directory.
      --config <file>  Configuration file. Default: papyrus.config.yml in the project directory.
      --no-color       Disable ANSI color output.
  -h, --help           Print help
